questions.text: With what call does the message of Zechariah begin (Zechariah 1:3)?

options.text: Build the house of the LORD, and I will turn unto you and bless your land
Turn ye unto me, and I will turn unto you, saith the LORD of hosts
Fear ye not the enemy, and I will turn unto you with everlasting mercy
Keep ye the holy feasts, and I will turn unto you and dwell with you

questions.text: What did Zechariah see in his first night vision (Zechariah 1:8)?

options.text: Four chariots between two mountains, having red, black, and white horses
An angel with a measuring line in his hand, going to measure Jerusalem
A man riding upon a red horse among myrtles, and behind him red and white horses
A candlestick all of gold with two olive trees by it, shining brightly

questions.text: What are the four carpenters sent to do according to Zechariah 1:21?

options.text: To forge the weapons of the king that shall protect Judah from the heathen
To build the holy temple which the heathen in the land had broken down
To measure the holy city of Jerusalem which was laid waste by foreign foes
To cast out the horns of the Gentiles which have scattered the land of Judah

questions.text: Why shall Jerusalem be inhabited without walls according to Zechariah 2:4-5?

options.text: For the multitude of men and cattle, and the LORD will be a wall of fire
Because no enemies threaten and the whole land shall rest in quiet peace
Because the ancient walls were destroyed and the rebuilding not yet begun
Because the angel with the measuring line commanded the city to be open

questions.text: How does Zechariah 2:8 describe God's care for his people?

options.text: He that blesseth you shall be blessed by the LORD for evermore
He that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye before God
He that reproacheth you shall soon be judged by the Lord of hosts
He that forsaketh you shall be cast away from the presence of God

questions.text: What is commanded unto all flesh in Zechariah 2:13?

options.text: To offer sacrifices and come with songs of thanksgiving unto mount Zion
To assemble in Jerusalem and hear the words of the prophets of the LORD
Be silent before the LORD, for he is raised up out of his habitation
To bow down before the holy temple and weep for the sins of the fathers

questions.text: Who stood at the right hand of Joshua to resist him (Zechariah 3:1-2)?

options.text: The angel of death who stood at his left hand to terrify him in fear
A false prophet who stood at his right hand to bring accusation of sin
A prince of the heathen who stood before him to demand tribute money
Satan, standing at his right hand to resist him before the holy angel

questions.text: What happened to Joshua's filthy garments according to Zechariah 3:4?

options.text: They were taken from him, his iniquity passed, and he was clothed with raiment
They were washed with holy water and anointed with precious oil in the temple
They were burned with fire, and he was commanded to mourn for seven days
They were delivered unto the priests to be kept in the sanctuary as a sign

questions.text: What announcement does the LORD make in Zechariah 3:8?

options.text: I will send my holy angel to deliver the daughter of Zion
Behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH unto you
I will establish a new king upon the throne of David of old
I will redeem my people from the hand of all foreign nations

questions.text: What word of the LORD is spoken unto Zerubbabel in Zechariah 4:6?

options.text: Not by gold or silver, but by the commandments of the law of Moses
Not by the wisdom of men, but by the mighty host of holy angels
Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD of hosts
Not by swords or bows, but by the everlasting arm of my covenant

questions.text: What question does the LORD ask in Zechariah 4:10?

options.text: Who is he that hath kept the commandments?
Who is he that hath rebuilt the sanctuary?
Who is he that hath sought after true wisdom?
Who hath despised the day of small things?

questions.text: Whom do the two olive trees represent in Zechariah 4:14?

options.text: The two anointed ones that stand by the Lord of the whole earth
The two prophets that shall preach repentance unto all the heathen
The two angels that keep watch over the gates of the sanctuary
The two kings of Judah and Israel that shall rule in righteousness

questions.text: What does the flying roll represent in Zechariah 5:3?

options.text: The everlasting covenant of God with the righteous
The curse that goeth forth against thieves and swearers
The message of peace unto all the scattered nations
The solemn book of remembrance written before the Lord

questions.text: What did Zechariah see in the ephah according to Zechariah 5:7-8?

options.text: A man, of whom the angel said: This is the idolatry of all the nations
A beast, of whom the angel said: This is the desolation of the temple
A woman, of whom the angel said: This is wickedness in all the land
An idol, of whom the angel said: This is the deceit of the heathen

questions.text: Whither was the ephah carried according to Zechariah 5:11?

options.text: Unto the land of Egypt, to be cast into the river
Unto the desert of Edom, to remain in the rocks
Unto the coast of Philistia, to be buried in sand
Unto the land of Shinar, to build it an house there

questions.text: From where did the four chariots come in Zechariah 6:1?

options.text: Out from between two mountains of brass
Out from the depths of the great wide sea
Out from the gates of the heavenly temple
Out from the valley of the holy judgment

questions.text: Upon whose head was the crown of silver and gold set in Zechariah 6:11?

options.text: Upon the head of Zerubbabel the governor of Judah
Upon the head of Joshua the high priest, Josedech's son
Upon the head of Zechariah the chosen prophet of God
Upon the head of Darius the mighty king of the Persians

questions.text: What is promised concerning the man whose name is The BRANCH (Zechariah 6:12-13)?

options.text: He shall wage war against the heathen, gather Israel, and reign as an earthly king
He shall gather the captives from Babylon, raise the walls, and lead the battle
He shall build the temple of the LORD, rule upon his throne, and be a priest
He shall administer the land, serve in the temple as priest, and govern the cities

questions.text: What question did the messengers ask in Zechariah 7:3?

options.text: Should we fast in the seventh month, as we have done these so many years past?
May we build the temple and offer sacrifices, as in the days before captivity?
May we return unto our own land, as our fathers did of old, without any danger?
Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these years?

questions.text: How did the LORD question the people concerning their fasting in Zechariah 7:5?

options.text: Did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
Who commanded you to fast in the temple?
When shall your days of fasting have end?
Why did ye not fast with all your hearts?

questions.text: What does the LORD require according to Zechariah 7:9?

options.text: Fast and pray, and let every man shew faithfulness and reverence to his brother
Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother
Offer sacrifices upon the altar, and let every man observe the holy sabbaths
Keep the holy commandments, and let every man honor the priests and the temple

questions.text: What shall Jerusalem be called according to Zechariah 8:3?

options.text: A city of the King, and the mountain of the LORD a place of peace
A city of peace, and the mountain of the LORD a hill of refreshment
A city of truth, and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain
A city of David, and the mountain of the LORD a dwelling of justice

questions.text: What picture of peace is portrayed in Zechariah 8:4-5?

options.text: Merchants fill the marketplace, and streets are full of goods from foreign lands
Watchmen stand on the walls, and streets are full of chariots and spears of war
Priests offer sacrifices, and streets are filled with sweet incense and singing
Old men and women dwell in the streets, and streets are full of playing children

questions.text: What will ten men from all nations do according to Zechariah 8:23?

options.text: Take hold of the skirt of a Jew, saying: We will go with you, for God is with you
Fight against Judah, saying: We will possess the land, for God gave it unto us
Subdue the cities of Judah, saying: We will rule over you, for our gods are mighty
Pay tribute unto the elders, saying: We will obey your law, for the king decreed

questions.text: How does the King come unto Zion in Zechariah 9:9?

options.text: As a mighty conqueror on a chariot, adorned with golden crowns and weapons of war
Just, and having salvation, lowly, and riding upon an ass, the foal of an ass
Glorious in great majesty on a white horse, accompanied by all the hosts of heaven
Clothed in royal purple, bearing a sceptre of iron to subdue all heathen nations

questions.text: What will the King cut off according to Zechariah 9:10?

options.text: He will multiply the chariots in Ephraim and the horses in Jerusalem
He will seize the horses and chariots of the heathen for his own hosts
The chariot from Ephraim, the horse from Jerusalem, and the battle bow
He will assemble the armies of all nations and march forth in battle

questions.text: By what did the LORD send forth the prisoners according to Zechariah 9:11?

options.text: By the mighty arm of the king and the strength of his warrior hosts
By the ransom of gold and silver paid unto the kings of the heathen
By the intercession of the priests and the daily sacrifice in Zion
By the blood of the covenant out of the pit wherein is no water

questions.text: Why did the people go their way as a flock in Zechariah 10:2?

options.text: Because idols spoke vanity, diviners saw a lie, and there was no shepherd
Because the heathen burned their towns and carried away their cattle
Because a great drought fell upon the pastures and destroyed the grass
Because the priests neglected the altar and refused to teach the law

questions.text: What comes forth out of Judah according to Zechariah 10:4?

options.text: The priest, the prophet, and the righteous ruler
The corner, the nail, and the battle bow of might
The judge, the king, and the captain of the host
The shepherd, the master builder, and the prophet

questions.text: How will the LORD gather his people in Zechariah 10:8?

options.text: He will sound the trumpet of war and assemble the hosts of Israel
He will send his prophets into all nations to bring back the exiles
He will hiss for them and gather them, for he hath redeemed them
He will build a highway through the desert for all that were lost

questions.text: What names did the prophet give to the two staves in Zechariah 11:7?

options.text: Mercy and Truth to guide the straying flock
Righteousness and Peace to lead the sheep
Strength and Honour to defend the assembly
Beauty and Bands, and he fed the flock

questions.text: What price was weighed for the prophet's wages in Zechariah 11:12?

options.text: Thirty pieces of silver, and it was cast unto the potter
Twenty pieces of silver, and it was given to the poor
Fifty shekels of gold, and it was placed in the treasury
Ten talents of brass, and it was delivered to the priests

questions.text: What does the LORD declare in Zechariah 11:15-16?

options.text: He will raise up a righteous shepherd to lead the flock safely
He will raise up a foolish shepherd which will not seek the lost
He will destroy all foreign shepherds and deliver his own sheep
He will appoint two faithful watchmen upon the walls of Jerusalem

questions.text: What will Jerusalem become unto the nations according to Zechariah 12:2-3?

options.text: A city of refuge wherein all foreign nations shall find quiet rest
A mighty fortress against which all heathen kings shall dash in vain
A cup of trembling and a burdensome stone, cutting all that lift it
A living fountain at which all thirsty people shall drink and be glad

questions.text: What spirit will the LORD pour out according to Zechariah 12:10?

options.text: The spirit of wisdom and understanding for all the council of elders
The spirit of judgment and burning against all adversaries of the land
The spirit of might and counsel to rebuild the ancient temple gates
The spirit of grace and of supplications upon the house of David

questions.text: To what is the mourning for the pierced one compared in Zechariah 12:10?

options.text: To mourning for an only son and bitterness for a firstborn
To weeping for a fallen king and lamentation for the temple
To sorrow for a barren field and mourning for a dead mother
To grief for a lost inheritance and despair in heavy captivity

questions.text: What shall be opened in that day according to Zechariah 13:1?

options.text: A treasury of gold and silver for rebuilding the temple
A fountain opened for sin and for uncleanness in Zion
A gate of righteousness for all the heathen that turn
A well of living water for the weary pilgrims in Judah

questions.text: What is commanded concerning the shepherd in Zechariah 13:7?

options.text: The shepherd shall be crowned, and sheep shall feed safely
The shepherd shall be delivered, and sheep shall be gathered
Smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall scatter
The shepherd shall depart, and the sheep shall follow after

questions.text: What shall happen unto the third part according to Zechariah 13:9?

options.text: They shall be carried away captive into Babylon until the appointed time
They shall dwell in the mountains and build strong cities in quietness
They shall fall by the sword because of the transgressions of fathers

questions.text: What shall happen to the mount of Olives in Zechariah 14:4?

options.text: It shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and west
It shall be made a plain from the rising to the going down of sun
It shall become a broad river flowing straight into the desert sea
It shall shake and fall down completely before the majesty of God

questions.text: What great truth is proclaimed in Zechariah 14:9?

options.text: The LORD will reign in Jerusalem, and the holy city shall dwell safely
The LORD shall be king over all the earth: one LORD, and his name one
The LORD will judge all the heathen, and his praise shall fill heaven
The LORD will show mercy to all nations, and everlasting peace prevail

questions.text: What shall be written upon the bells of the horses in Zechariah 14:20?

options.text: Glory be unto our God
Praise be unto the LORD
HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD
The LORD God is our King
